title: Labelled email diagram
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 89 (Labelled email diagram (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 89: Email features and online manners. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

head: Part
What it does
rows: what the email is about, in a few words
Yours sincerely or See you soon

panels.title: Online manners
points: Be polite and kind: no shouting in CAPITALS
Never share your address, school or passwords; ask an adult first

model.title: Fix: no subject; hey; WHEN DO YOU OPEN; bye

parts.text: Body: Please could you tell me your opening times in July?
Sign-off: Thank you for your help. Yours faithfully, (first name only)

keywords.def: a short title that says what the email is about
the person who receives the message
a file sent with an email

questions.q: Write a subject line for an email about a lost hat
questions.a: For example: Lost hat on Tuesday

questions.q: Rewrite politely: SEND ME A MAP
questions.a: Please could you send me a map?

questions.q: Should you put your home address in an email to a stranger?
Core: label the parts of an email and write three online manners rules
Extend: write three good subject lines for three different emails
Stretch: explain why checking before you send matters
questions.a: You cannot unsend an email; mistakes or unkind words stay

questions.q: Which is the best subject line for asking about park opening times?
questions.a: B) Question about opening times. It is short and says exactly what the email is about.
